📚 Tokenized Stocks Explained: What You Actually Own

• A tokenized stock is not automatically identical to directly owning the underlying company share.

• Issuer-sponsored, custodial and synthetic structures can give holders materially different rights and counterparty exposure.

• Before evaluating a product, understand custody, redemption, voting/dividend rights, jurisdiction and the authoritative ownership record.
